import numpy as np
def _ring(n, t, tn):
    h = np.zeros((n, n))
    for i in range(n - 1):
        h[i, i + 1] = h[i + 1, i] = t[i % len(t)]
    h[0, n - 1] = h[n - 1, 0] = tn
    return h
assert np.allclose(np.asarray(singlet_ground_state(_ring(6, [-1.9, -2.2], 0.9), 4.0), dtype=float), target)
